description: This file defines the 'Rom' class, which is part of a software project for ECU tuning and calibration. The class manages a collection of 'Table' objects representing calibration tables and related data within a ROM image, providing methods for populating, updating, and managing tables, as well as handling file-related information and GUI components.

classes.name: Rom
classes.description: Represents a ROM image containing calibration tables for ECU tuning. Manages table data, file information, and integrates with GUI components for display and interaction.

methods.name: refreshDisplayedTables
methods.description: Updates the visual representation of tables, organized by categories, based on current settings.

methods.name: addTable
methods.description: Adds or updates a Table object within the ROM's internal collection.

methods.name: removeTable
methods.description: Removes a specified Table from the ROM.

methods.name: getTableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Table by its name with exception handling for invalid or not found cases.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds tables matching a regex pattern within the collection.

methods.name: populateTables
methods.description: Populates each Table with data from the binary ROM data and updates GUI progress.

methods.name: setEditStamp
methods.description: Extracts and sets an edit stamp from ROM data for versioning or identification.

methods.name: setRomID
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the ROM.

methods.name: getRomID
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier object for the ROM.

methods.name: getRomIDString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ROM's ID.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of the ROM state, including ID and tables.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this ROM.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns a collection of all tables contained in the ROM.

methods.name: getTableNodes
methods.description: Returns the internal vector of TableTreeNode objects.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the ROM.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the current state of tables and updates binary data, returning the byte array.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears all table data and GUI frames associated with the ROM.

methods.name: getRealFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the binary data representing the ROM.

methods.name: setFullFileName
methods.description: Updates filename and GUI titles for associated table frames.

methods.name: isAbstract
methods.description: Checks if the ROM is marked as abstract (not fully loaded or editable).

methods.name: setAbstract
methods.description: Sets the abstract flag for the ROM.

methods.name: refreshTableCompareMenus
methods.description: Refreshes UI components related to table comparisons.
